text:
Morgan: quick heads-up — the runbooks page for rollout-runner is rendering an extra raw HTML block in the 'Debugging' section. Noticed it on staging and prod. Screenshot png is 403 from the CDN. Who owns this page?

Jamie: which page exactly? link? :eyes:

Morgan: https://docs.redwoodai.internal/runbooks/rollout-runner — scroll to 'Debugging' and the inline example. I can repro with a simple markdown render locally.

Lina: I saw that earlier today, assumed it was a bad MDX embed. The image path looks like `/assets/runbooks/rr-debug.png` but requests to the asset return 403.

Sam: pinging storage infra — @docs-bot can you paste the deploy artifact id for the latest docs build?

docs-bot: latest docs deploy: deploy-2026-03-14-1789 (sha: a1b2c3d). No build errors, but asset sync job reported 1 warning for runbook images.

Morgan: putting the minimal repro snippet below — rendering shows the raw HTML comment and the image 403 in prod.

Morgan: ```markdown
> **Example**
>
> ```bash
> curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/health
> ```
>
> <!-- debug: this comment is leaking into render -->
>
> ![debug flow](/assets/runbooks/rr-debug.png)
> ```

Jamie: that HTML comment should be stripped by the MDX pipeline, hmm. Two things to triage: 1) who owns that runbook page (owner in frontmatter?) 2) why the asset sync returned 403.

Lina: I can own the doc edit (quick PR to remove offending comment and re-run the build). For the 403 I'll need infra to confirm object ACLs.

Sam: I checked S3 logs — the object rr-debug.png exists under docs-bucket/private/ but the sync job attempted to copy from docs-staging/ and hit a permission block. Looks like the presigned URL generator omitted a role. I'll open a ticket with infra-ops now.

Morgan: thanks. If Lina can do a tiny docs PR to remove the HTML comment and add an alternate hosted image path as a fallback, that should unblock the render for now. Example fallback: `![debug flow](https://cdn.redwood.ai/backup/rr-debug.png)`.

Lina: will do. ETA 30–45m, will tag reviewers.

Jamie: once PR is up @Sam can you re-run the asset sync or give a temp ACL flip so the image copies? If infra needs an approved change, we can roll a quick policy exception until we fix the role mapping.

Sam: heading to infra-ops channel, will request the ACL flip and post back here. If they need an owner signoff, @Lina please +1 the transient exception.

Lina: +1, if it helps unblock production render.

docs-bot: ticket created: INFRA-2247 — requested transient ACL change for docs-bucket object copy.

Morgan: perfect. After Lina's PR and the transient ACL fix, can someone confirm the rendered page looks normal in prod? I'll do a sweep of related runbooks for stray HTML comments.

Jamie: noted. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Sam: update: infra approved temporary ACL flip, will push in ~10m and notify.

Lina: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4123 — removed the comment and added fallback CDN link. small description and link to INFRA-2247.

Morgan: checked prod after the ACL flip + PR merge — render fixed, image loads, raw HTML gone. closing my manual check.

Jamie: nice, marking this thread resolved. If anyone sees similar stray MDX comments, ping docs-crawl to surface them for a sweep.
